voice.summary: Quartz UI sounds like good documentation written by someone who actually uses the components. It names the pattern, shows the keyboard behaviour and answers the question in the first line.
dos: Answer the question in the opening sentence
Mention the keyboard shortcut next to each pattern
Keep headings to four words or fewer
donts: Do not bury the answer under a preamble
Do not use exclamation marks in docs

taglines: Open what you need, nothing more
Expand all, collapse all, break nothing
boilerplate: Quartz UI is a component library whose accordions, tabs and menus share one consistent keyboard model and need no framework.

microcopy.success: Panel opened. Focus moved to its content.
microcopy.error: That panel could not open. Reload the page and try again.
microcopy.empty: No questions yet. Add the first one.

logo.note: Stacked panels echo the layers of an accordion and the pieces of a component kit.
